examples.title: Example 1: Implementing an Editable Title Bar with a Custom Right Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement an editable title bar with a left icon, main title, and custom right icon area.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing an Editable Title Bar with Background Blur and a Profile Picture
examples.description: This example shows how to implement an editable title bar with background blur, a profile picture, and custom margins.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing Screen Reader Announcement for the Custom Button on the Right Side
examples.description: This example customizes the screen reader announcement text by setting the accessibilityText, accessibilityDescription, and accessibilityLevel properties of the custom button on the right side of the title bar. This functionality is supported since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Left Icon as the Default Focus
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the leftIconDefaultFocus attribute in EditableTitleBar to ensure the left icon obtains focus by default in the focused state.
The leftIconDefaultFocus API is added to EditableTitleBar since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting a Custom Right Icon as the Default Focus
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the defaultFocus attribute in EditableTitleBar to ensure the right icon obtains focus by default in the focused state.
The defaultFocus API is added to EditableTitleBarMenuItem since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting the Symbol Icon
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use symbolStyle in EditableTitleBarMenuItem to set custom symbol icons. This functionality is supported since API version 18.
